Clicks will come from curiosity, but purchase intent drops unless the ad points to the in-stock emerald and crystal versions of the same bracelet. A full-bleed saturated persimmon is a real colour stop, the proven Woven Hoops are large and sharp, and 'The Everything Issue' says Shop All without explaining it. The Story uses the full screen, which suits the account's Stories-beat-Feeds pattern. The only issue is the hero price hidden in vertical type.

defects: Feed: three alignment systems compete. The poem is centred (x250-830, y110-345), the footnote is right-aligned at x1008 (y447-585) and the logo is left-aligned at x72 (y1228-1278). The logo floats alone beside the arils.

defects: Both: the foot line 'Fig. 2 onwards: everything else, ₹599 onwards.' (Feed x120-775, baseline 1250; Story baseline 1462) uses 'onwards' twice in one line. It reads as a copy error, not a pun.

Story: 420px of blank cream below the footer (y1500-1920) and 290px above. The diptych is not enlarged to use the 9:16 frame.

ads.note: The most fashion-literate idea in the set ('Slip, model’s own.'), with a clean hierarchy and on-model photos that echo the best-converting carousel. It feels like a real magazine page.

defects: Both: the triptych grounds don't match. Panels 1-2 show a white plinth with diagonal edges cutting across (Feed x72-688, y420-890), and panel 3 is plain warmer beige. The equal frames hold unequal worlds.

ads.note: Calm, premium and well gridded: the most catalogue-correct frame here. It lacks a clever line, and the three panels need matched ground and scale.

defects: Both: a heavy near-black moulding (about 12px, Feed x152-928, y178-1162) frames the mat. It is not in the spec and reads as a poster-shop frame against the burnt wall.

Set-level: it uses the same H08 photo as A03.
ads.note: 'Hang at ear height.' is a lovely twist, and the bottom-weighted mat is correct. Lose the black frame, move the logo off the mat and lift the wall a step, and it would be frameable.

defects: Story: the top-right corner shows the edge of the plaster slab and the grey studio beyond, a diagonal from (500,0) to (1080,170) with luminance 113-157 against a 220 ground. The set is visible.
Feed: soft white light-leak blooms hug the right edge (x1040-1080, y140-240 and y1030-1220; luminance 236-248 against a 213 ground). They look accidental.
Both: dark plaster speckles sit inside the type zones, around 'COLOPHON' and under the title (Feed about x640-700, y975-1010). That is noise behind the small type.
Both: 'COLOPHON' (gold Jost 22-24px) is a word most of the audience will not know. The label adds a riddle above an already clever line.

Feed: the title and both body lines are bottom-stacked (y970-1215) while the logo sits alone at top (y72-121). It works, but the bangle top (y225) to the logo is only about 100px, which crowds the top.
ads.note: 'Set in gold tone.' is the wittiest exact line in the set, on a calm still life with real air. Clean the Story corner and the edge flares before final.

defects: Feed: the piece credit 'BOLD NOCTURNE CHAIN · ₹1,799' (x70-615, y1258-1282) is 26px gold Jost on cream. On a 360px phone it is about 9px with low contrast, so the hero's only price is the faintest text on the frame.
Feed: the macro gives no sense of scale or body. The pavé link fills x180-990, y410-1020, and she cannot tell whether it is a necklace or a bracelet. Add 'NECKLACE' to the credit.
Story: the logo (x72-290, y272-322) and credit (x465-1010, y300-322) sit right on the y=270 safe line, under the profile and progress bar on tall phones. Move both down about 60px.
Story: y1450-1920 is empty soft shadow (25% of the screen) and the link ends at y1415. Shift the crop so the link sits lower and centred.
Stock: the hero has 17 units. That is fine for a Shop All click, but rotate it out if the chain sells down.
ads.note: This is the cream ad that survives the half-second test, because the pavé sparkle still reads at 360px and the link is huge. The idiom turns into the shop-all promise with no effort, and the breadth line sits right under it. Its weakness is that the macro never says what the piece is or how it wears. It is a top-4 ad, so run it.

defects: Feed: the framed photo spans only x72-772 (65% of the width), so the bracelet is just x175-620, y675-1005. That is far smaller than in the 4.32% full-bleed original of this photo.
Feed: the right column x790-1060, y260-920 is empty maroon, and the logo (x805-1008, y190-240) floats above it with nothing to anchor it.
Feed: the label italics 'Gold tone, cubic zirconia' (x822-950, y1052-1108) are about 22px grey on cream, about 7px on a phone and illegible.

Both: the only product shown cannot be bought, and nothing bridges to the same baguette bracelet in Emerald green or Crystal (₹1,499, 17 and 38 in stock). Add one whisper line under the breadth line (Feed y1240, Story y1465), for example 'Still on view: in emerald green and crystal.'
Story: this is the Feed layout on a taller ground. y0-290 and y1490-1920 are flat maroon (38% of the screen). The frame should run about 936px wide.
ads.note: The line is honest and clever, and the maroon wall stands out in a cream feed. The trouble is that the account's best-converting photo is shrunk inside a mat, and the hero is sold out. Clicks will come from curiosity, but purchase intent drops unless the ad points to the in-stock emerald and crystal versions of the same bracelet. Fix the bridge line and enlarge the Story frame, then run.

defects: Feed and Story: the rotated credit 'COVER: WOVEN HOOPS, ₹1,199' (Feed x988-1012, y208-640; Story x988-1012, y428-858) is 26px vertical text and unreadable on a phone, so the hero's price is effectively invisible.

Feed: the masthead small caps 'ISSUE NO. 1' (x70-275, y95-115) and '₹599 TO ₹2,399' (x755-1010, y95-115) are about 9px on a phone. The price range is the key shop-all fact and is lost here, so repeat it in the bottom cover line (y1235-1265).
Feed: the cover line 'Inside: rings, earrings…' (x225-855, y1235-1265) sits on textured linen, which makes it weak at 360px.
Fatigue: this ad shares H08 with A11, so never run both in one flight. H08 also carried the earlier Woven Hoops ads, so warm audiences have seen it.
ads.note: This is the strongest ad in the set. A full-bleed saturated persimmon is a real colour stop, the proven Woven Hoops are large and sharp, and 'The Everything Issue' says Shop All without explaining it. The Story uses the full screen, which suits the account's Stories-beat-Feeds pattern. The only issue is the hero price hidden in vertical type.

defects: Story: the photo is a 2:1 strip at y540-1090 (29% of the screen), with y0-540 and y1420-1920 flat black. H07 is a native 1080x1920 frame, so run it full bleed at 1.0x and put the subtitles over the dark bokeh.

Feed: the top letterbox y0-300 holds only the logo (22% of the frame flat black), and y1230-1350 is flat too. A taller 4:5 photo window would let the image dominate without upscaling.
Feed: the subtitle block is left-aligned at x258, while the logo and the category line are centred on x540. Real subtitles are centred.
Fatigue: H07 ran this season as Diwali 10 ad 05, so expect frequency overlap with warm audiences.
ads.note: The Feed has the best stop and the best audience insight in the batch. A black frame plus subtitles gets read by reflex, and 'I'll get the rest myself' speaks directly to the self-buying woman while meaning the whole shop. The Story throws all of that away on a thin strip, and the hoops are small in both. Rebuild the Story full bleed.

defects: Feed: the bracelet is only x578-780, y500-725 (about 3% of the frame), about 65px on a phone. The hand and the teak step carry the frame, not the jewellery.
Feed: the poster band y0-400 takes 30% of the frame with five text items (kicker, 'Come in.', two offer lines, breadth line), well over the ~12% text target.
Feed and Story: 'The rangoli’s done.' ties the ad to Diwali week (8 Nov). Expect it to read stale and fatigue within about 10 days, which is wrong for an evergreen Shop All flight.
Story: y0-330 is flat cream above the band, and the bracelet (x578-780, y815-1030) is still small even though the rangoli fills y1400-1920.
Fatigue: H03 ran as Diwali 10 ad 02, so the photo overlaps with what warm audiences just saw.
ads.note: 'Come in.' is big, confident type and the pastel rangoli is pretty, but the jewellery is a speck and the invitation is close to a generic 'shop now'. The Story is the better of the two. Shrink the text band so the wrist gets more height, and run it only through Diwali week.

defects: Feed: the product captions (x72-370 and x722-1008, y758-785) are 26px grey italic, about 9px on a phone and nearly unreadable.

Feed: the lower half y740-1260 is five stacked text tiers (captions, headline, subline, offer, breadth line), so below the photos the frame reads as a text card. Drop the italic breadth line or merge it into the offer.
Feed: the offer 'MIX ANY TWO: 10% OFF, APPLIED IN YOUR BAG' (x155-928, y1040-1062) is gold Jost on cream with low contrast.
Feed and Story: a visible skin blemish on the pearl ear at Feed x700-725, y365-390 (Story x700-725, y690-715) reads as a mark at full size.
Story: this is the Feed layout on a taller ground, with y0-290 and y1480-1920 flat cream (38%). Both photos could run about 1.2x taller.

ads.note: These are the on-model listing photos the account's best purchase driver is built on, with two large, desirable earrings at different price points. The mismatch idea makes browsing for 'my pair' the reason to click. The offer is the twist, not a shout, and it lifts order value. It is text-heavy below the fold, but it is a solid converter, so run it.

defects: Feed: the first line read, 'Rangoli, for ears.' (x345-735, y115-165), and line 2, 'Elaichi, around the wrist.', describe pieces that are not in the frame. Only the anaar necklace (x108-622, y520-890) is shown, so two-thirds of the copy points at nothing.

Feed: a blush bust on a blush wall gives weak figure-ground contrast. Only the anaar halves (x690-1055, y740-1090) pop at 360px.
Story: the same three-line verse at y430-650 is a slow read for a half-second Story tap.
Fatigue: H06 ran as Diwali 10 ad 01 this season.

The house formula works because the picture shows the Indian thing and the stone together. Rebuild it as a triptych of the three named pieces, or as one line ('Anaar, at the throat.'), but do not spend on this version.

defects: Feed: 'Fig. 2 onwards: everything else, ₹599 onwards.' (x120-775, y1228-1262) says 'onwards' twice and reads clumsy. It is also the only shop-all line and the smallest text on the frame.
Feed: the plate is inset with 120px margins (x120-960, y172-1055), giving up about 22% of the width that a full-bleed rangoli photo would use as stop power.
Feed: 'PRISM CLUSTER STUDS · ₹1,499' (x440-960, y1083-1103) and 'THE COLLECTION' (x120-415, y88-108) are grey Jost, about 9px on a phone.
Story: the plate runs y383-1268 with flat paper at y0-280 and y1480-1920. The studs (x260-830, y1055-1190) are no bigger than in the Feed, so the Story format adds nothing.
Fatigue: the headline repeats the 5.21% 'Rangoli you can wear.' word for word. That is fine for cold audiences but stale for anyone who saw the original.
ads.note: The violet, pink and yellow cones are among the strongest colour stops here, and the studs are big, sharp and desirable. The book-figure frame shrinks the photo, and the shop-all twist is buried in a repetitive small line. Rewrite it (for example 'Fig. 2 onwards: everything else, from ₹599.') and widen the Story plate, then run.

defects: Feed: the choker drops are tiny (pendant chain x300-335, y660-860, about 12px wide on a phone), and the cuff is only x818-970, y840-970.
Feed: lips and chin fill the top of both tiles (y270-470). Two identical mouth crops side by side use space the jewellery could have.
Feed: the captions (x72-395 and x564-805, y1090-1118) are 28px italic, about 9px on a phone.
Story: this is the Feed layout on a taller ground, with y0-300 and y1490-1920 flat paper (38%).
Copy: 'Slip, model’s own.' is fashion-credit jargon many in the audience will not parse. Line 2, 'Everything else, from ₹599.', does the selling, so keep it this prominent.
ads.note: This has the best shop-all line in the batch: a clear price floor, and 'everything else' invites browsing. Mustard, skin and gold is exactly the on-model catalogue look that drives the account's purchases. The jewellery is a little small inside face-heavy crops, but it is the most purchase-ready creative here, so run it.

defects: Feed: flat cream at y0-200 and y1130-1350 (31% of the frame) around beige tiles gives a low-contrast catalogue look, and nothing stops a thumb at 360px.
Feed: the middle tile (x392-688, y330-890) crops the knot bangle into a band fragment, so 'Knotted.' labels a product nobody can identify on a phone.
Feed: the tile grounds do not match (tile 1 is a grey-white plinth, tile 3 at x712-1008 is warm pink-beige), so it reads as three shoots, not one edit.
Story: flat y0-350 and y1400-1920 (45% of the screen) around a small triptych.
Copy: three craft adjectives with no Indian reference and no tension. It is the 'X, not Y' grammar with the 'not Y' removed.
ads.note: This is the sleepy-wallpaper failure: gold on beige on beige, like every demi-fine brand's grid post. The polished dome huggie is lovely, but the frame gives a cold scroller no reason to stop and no question to click on.

defects: Feed: the framed print shrinks the hoops (lower hoop x420-650, y585-830) to about two-thirds of their size in A03, which uses the same photo full bleed.
Feed: the mat line 'WOVEN HOOPS · ₹1,199' (x230-560, y1100-1120) is 24px grey, about 8px on a phone, and 'NEXT ROOM' (x440-640, y1203-1222) is low-contrast tan on brown.
Feed: the burnt-brown ground reads muddy at 360px and dulls the persimmon orange.
Story: flat brown at y0-300 and y1490-1920. The frame (x128-952, y418-1372) does not use the full height.
Fatigue: it duplicates A03's H08 photo and A02's framed-print device, so it cannot share a flight with either.
ads.note: 'Hang at ear height.' is the wittiest line here, but it is the same photo as A03, framed smaller on a muddier ground. With ₹1,000 a day there is no room to split spend across one photo twice. Keep it on the bench as the A03 replacement when A03 fatigues.

defects: Feed: 'COLOPHON' (x447-635, y972-990) is printer's jargon most of the audience will not know, and the pun 'Set in gold tone.' (x215-865, y1025-1135) depends on it.
Feed: the gold wax seal (x352-592, y535-725) is as big and as gold as the bangle's knot (x560-760, y455-600), so the eye lands on the seal, not the product.
Feed: a blush plaster ground with a cream envelope is low contrast, and the frame reads as soft wallpaper at 360px.
Feed: light-flare blobs at the right edge (x1000-1080, y60-260 and y980-1120) look like stains at phone size.
Story: the grey set edge shows top-right (x540-1080, y0-170), and flare blobs sit at x1000-1080, y480-640 and y1330-1500.
Proof: H16 ('Sealed with a kiss.') is the weakest photo in the pool at 3.90% CTR.
ads.note: It is beautiful but sleepy, and the line asks her to know what a colophon is. The gift-box line is a useful reassurance but it sits in small type. The Story's full-bleed bangle is the only strength. It will not earn its share of ₹1,000 a day.

defects: Story: the breadth line 'Rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets. / ₹599 to ₹2,399.' is set at 30 px CG at x72-490, y598-668. That is about 10 px on a 360 px phone: legible but the weakest line in the frame.
Story: the logo and the gold credit (26 px Jost) share one running-head row at y272-321, only 2 px inside the 270 safe line. That is compliant but tight under the IG header.

Feed: the pavé link sits dead centre (x200-990, y410-1020), not on a third. The composition is a little static. Copy, price (₹1,799) and fidelity are all correct: the crop is a 0.75x downscale, and the mean colour matches the source within 3 units.
ads.note: Clean, true and beautiful. One logo, the correct price, no banned words, everything in the Story inside y272-668. The line opens the whole shop. Ready to run.

defects: Feed: the museum label body is 26 px CG and 'Gold tone, cubic zirconia' is 26 px grey italic (#6E645E) at x822-950, y1052-1108. SOLD is 24 px Jost at y1128-1146. That is about 8-9 px on a phone, so readable only up close.
Feed: the label breaks as 'Baguette Tennis / Bracelet, / Ruby red', which leaves 'Bracelet,' alone on its own line at x822-910, y985-1005.
Story: the framed print (x72-772, y520-1392) holds only about 36% of the frame. The Story reads smaller than the Feed, though everything sits inside y295-1482.

The H18 sold-out rule is fully met: a red dot with SOLD, no price, nothing implying it can be bought, and the headline sends people to the rest. The bracelet really is gold tone, so the label is true.
ads.note: An honest, elegant use of the best-converting photo, and compliant with the H18 rule. The only weakness is the small label type. Ready to run (raise the label to 28-30 px if there is time).

defects: Feed and Story: the price credit 'COVER: WOVEN HOOPS, ₹1,199' is 24 px Jost at 80% ink, rotated 90 degrees, on mottled linen. It sits at x988-1012, y210-635 (Feed) and x988-1012, y428-855 (Story). At 360 px it is about 8 px and sideways, so it cannot be read. The only product price in the ad is effectively invisible.
Feed: 'Inside: rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets.' (38 px CG) sits on coarse linen weave at x225-855, y1232-1268. The texture breaks up the thin serifs. Story has the same problem at y1432-1468.
The photo is H08 full-bleed at 1.0x, the same framing as the earlier Woven Hoops ads. A11 uses the same H08 photo and A04 the same product, so three of the twelve sell Woven Gold Hoops.
The magazine-cover format uses only NAIRA's own logo as the masthead (allowed). 'WOVEN HOOPS' as a short name avoids the bare word 'gold'. Both are fine.
ads.note: A fun 'Everything Issue' idea with correct facts. Fix: set the cover credit horizontally at 26-28 px (for example under the rule, right-aligned), and put a soft paper strip or a darker ink weight behind the 'Inside' line.

defects: Story: the photo band is only 540 px tall (y545-1083) in a 1920 frame, with 545 px of flat black above and 837 px below. On a phone the hoops are about 93 px wide and the Story feels empty and under-sold. H07 is 1920 tall, so a taller crop at 1.0x (for example 1080x860) is available.
Story: the logo floats alone at y344-393, 150 px above the band, so it is disconnected from the scene.
Feed: the band's top edge (y300) slices across the palm at the finger roots (x330-830). This is acceptable as a letterbox, but the hand reads as cut.

The categories line is 26 px gold Jost at y1150-1172 (Feed) and y1347-1370 (Story), and the price line is 36 px gold italic. Both are legible but faint on black. No product is named or priced, and nothing is false.
ads.note: A witty self-purchase line and a good Feed. The Story wastes the frame. Fix by enlarging the cinematic band in the Story (taller crop at 1.0x) and tightening the logo to it. The Feed can run as is.

defects: Feed and Story: 'ADMISSION FREE. / SHIPPING TOO.' is 24 px Jost at 75% ink, the smallest text in the ad. It sits at x735-1010, y218-275 (Feed) and x740-1010, y485-542 (Story), about 8 px on a phone.
Feed: the forearm runs into the hard paper-band edge at y404 (x640-1010), and in the Story at y700. The cut is clean but abrupt.
